name: Thistle Goldworthy
title: Travelling Merchant
description: A stout, cheerful halfling who works the Merchant's Highway with a wagon full of luxury goods, odd remedies and gossip, and who has never once given anything away for free.

greeting.first_time: Well met, traveller! Looking for a bit of luxury on this dusty road?
greeting.returning: Back again, eh? The wagon's still here, and so are my prices.

main_menu.text: Silks, spices, remedies, and the best gossip between the Kingdom and Goldenhaven. What'll it be?

browse_shop.text: Feast your eyes. Everything's genuine. Mostly.

sell_items.text: Let's see what you've got. I pay fair. Ish.

ask_gossip.text: Gossip? The old watchtower down the road has a fire burning in it at night. Black smoke, and no one I know lit it. I've started driving past it rather faster than the mule likes.

goodbye.text: Safe roads and heavy purses to you!
